note: Fixed, versioned evaluation panel. Chronic indices are 'hidden' from the model: docs/ and AGENTS.md never mention specific chronic ids or their dynamics. Changing this file changes the benchmark; bump version.

horizon_rationale.pilot: 96 steps: cheap first signal. DN does NOT trip by 96 (calibrated DN survival 381-1097), so survival is not the axis here — reward (loss/redispatch optimization) is. Fast, validates the LLM operates correctly.
horizon_rationale.standard: 1200 steps: the survival-discriminating horizon. Do-nothing TRIPS on every pilot chronic by ~800-1097, so a capable agent must outlast passive AND beat it on reward. This is the real benchmark.
horizon_rationale.baselines_full: 8064 steps (28 days): full chronic length for the free baselines (cheap: seconds-minutes each) to pin the DN anchor across the whole chronic and characterize the natural cascade.

safety.thinking_time_per_step: unlimited (skill-only; no per-turn deadline; gentle auto-continue only when idle)
